title: vLLM request latency (mean by stage)
description: Mean queue, prefill, decode, first-token and end-to-end latency per finished request. Rising queue time means requests wait to start; rising decode time can reflect longer responses or slower decoding. Means hide tails, and first-token/end-to-end stages overlap the other stages; requires engine telemetry. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No vLLM rows for this run. If the whole rank is blank, the engine exporter is down rather than six separate faults.
